text:
maria: Kicking off a long-horizon roadmap thread for routing policies + multi-region tenancy + tenant isolation. We need crisp launch criteria, tradeoffs, and prioritized customer asks for the Q3+ initiative. Quick takes please.
kevin: We should formalize SLA tiers per routing lane. Suggest: low-latency (p99 < 120ms), standard (p99 < 250ms), cost-optimized (p99 < 500ms). Ties into tenant pricing and quota limits.
sanjay: For scope, define isolation modes: shared (best-effort), soft-slice (logical quotas + KV namespaces), hard-slice (dedicated infra). I'll run infra cost multipliers: rough guess shared=1.0, soft-slice=1.15-1.25, hard-slice=1.3-1.5 depending on model.
lisa: Customer update: major healthcare prospect will require EU residency, VPC peering, and audit logs. They asked about dedicated lanes for compliance. Capture as enterprise must-have.
noah: From routing side: propose policy DSL v0: route selectors, SLOs, fallback chains, and canary rules. Example:```policy {
  id: "lane:lowlatency"
  slo: "p99<=120ms"
  fallbacks: ["m-small", "m-xsmall"]
  canary: {pct: 5, duration: "15m"}
}
```
emma: Telemetry idea: an "isolation_score" per tenant (0-100) combining p99 variance, KV cache churn, and error spike frequency. Use to auto-recommend lane. Thresholds: <30 shared, 30-70 soft-slice, >70 recommend hard-slice.
oliver: Ops perspective: we need a migration playbook and an "erosion window" to avoid double-cost when moving tenants between slices (KV warmup + cache prefill). Also need runbook for rolling tenants to fallback when a slice is overloaded.
maria: Launch criteria proposal (draft): (1) SLA matrix defined and documented, (2) policy DSL v0 implemented + tests, (3) telemetry (isolation_score) computed in prod for sample tenants, (4) migration playbook + automation for soft-slice, (5) cost bands validated. Any objections?
kevin: No objections. Also require e2e validation harness with synthetic tails to ensure p99 guarantees.
sanjay: Add ops burden estimate per isolation mode (headcount + oncall impact). I'll attach numbers in PRD.
lisa: I'll surface top 5 enterprise asks and confirm residency specifics. Also pushing customer for acceptance criteria for on-prem vs VPC.
noah: I'll draft the policy DSL RFC and include examples for multi-region failover and model-version fallback chains.
emma: Will prototype the isolation_score dashboard and recommend thresholds.
oliver: Ops will prototype the migration runbook and simulate warmup using traffic replays.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Routing ecosystem roadmap sync" Wed 09:30 Zoom.
maria: Action items captured. I'll spin up a PRD draft by Friday and assign owners. Please update if priorities change.
kevin: thumbs up
lisa: thanks, pinging SEs for customer confirmation.
maria: Thanks all — aim to have a customer-facing one-pager ready after next sync.
